ownerOrderedAdditions.orderedBy: Gonzalo (in-session, named each of the five gaps)
ownerOrderedAdditions.demandEvidence: NO GSC QUERY CITED FOR FOUR OF THE FIVE PAIRS, and that is stated rather than dressed up. The gaps are buyer gaps the owner named directly: the site already has dental, med spa and plastic surgery pages but nothing for a clinic that is none of those (chiropractic, physical therapy, functional medicine, walk-in); nothing for creators and influencers, who are their own buyer rather than a business; nothing for an agency or photographer who sells the shoot and subcontracts post-production; nothing for salons, barbershops and nail studios; and an automotive page aimed at dealerships rather than at detail, tint and wrap shops. The white-label pair is the one with a surface behind it: the repo's own niche prospect scraper treats agencies and photographers as the highest contact-quality segment in the outbound lane, which is the segment this page answers. Each pair ships with title, meta description, FAQPage and Service schema built from the visible copy, a breadcrumb trail, inbound links from the English and Spanish services hubs, and three outbound links to sibling services.
